Deterministic stratified 70/30 train/test split

Source: R/datasets.R
make_split.Rd

Maintains the per-class proportions of `y` in both halves. Reproducible given `seed`.

Usage

make_split(y, seed, train_frac = 0.7)

Arguments

y

Integer vector of binary labels.

seed

Integer seed.

train_frac

Fraction of cases assigned to train. Default 0.70 to match the benchmark.

Value

Logical vector of length `length(y)`; `TRUE` = in train.

Examples

set.seed(1)
y <- rbinom(100, 1, 0.3)
in_tr <- make_split(y, seed = 42)
table(in_tr, y)
#>        y
#> in_tr    0  1
#>   FALSE 21 10
#>   TRUE  47 22
